scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Hello, would you
like to enter the
Auction Hall?
scripts.translation:
[拍卖行向导]
您好，请问您想进入拍卖行吗？

scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Great! Well then,
I hope you have fun
and enjoy the auction~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖行向导]
太好了！那么，祝您玩得愉快，享受拍卖的乐趣吧~

[拍卖行向导]
祝您拍卖愉快。

scripts.text:
[Auction Hall Guide]
Alright then,
see you later.
If you change your
mind, please come
and enjoy the auctions~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖行向导]
好的，那再见了。
如果您改变主意，请随时来享受拍卖的乐趣~

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Welcome to the Auction Hall.
Would you like to view the goods?
scripts.translation:
[拍卖经纪人]
欢迎来到拍卖行。
您想看看商品吗？

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Very well.
Please take
a look, and see
What's being offered~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖经纪人]
好的。
请过目，看看有什么好东西~

scripts.text:
[Auction Broker]
Very well, then.
If you change your
mind, then please
come and check
out the auctions~
scripts.translation:
[拍卖经纪人]
好的。
如果您改变主意，请随时来看看拍卖~
